description: An HTML file implementing the front-end interface for a database visualizer, including UI components, styling, and client-side JavaScript for database and table data fetching and display.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by fetching from the server.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cell contents, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncate.
